concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 (placeholder fallback) vs spec.md:FR-002/US-1 and constitution Principle VII
concerns.text: T002 authorizes a rule-based placeholder ("Generated comment for function <name>.") in the `llm_comment` field when the HF API permanently fails. FR-002 requires comments 'generated by the CodeLlama-7B model via the HuggingFace API'; US-1 scenario 1 requires `llm_comment` 'populated with text generated by the model'. A template string in the LLM condition breaks condition isolation (Principle VII) — the observed effect is no longer attributable solely to LLM-generated comments. The plan's edge-case table documents the fallback, but the spec never permits it. Either exclude failed snippets (as with invalid docstrings) or amend the spec to document the validity threat; T002's verification ('llm_comment is non-empty') silently weakens FR-002.

T012 checks for `requirements.txt` at 'the repository root', but the constitution requires it at `projects/PROJ-217-evaluating-the-impact-of-llm-generated-c/code/` (and all runnable code under `code/`, while the plan/tasks place code under `src/`). The task enforces a constraint that contradicts the constitution's stated path; reconcile before CI enforces the wrong location.

SC-009 says 'if power is lower, a limitation report is generated and the study design is revised'. T007 only writes a limitation note; no task revises the study design or re-runs recruitment on a shortfall. Either add a design-revision step or make the spec's expectation explicit (limitation note only) so the acceptance criterion is not silently dropped.
